scientific_integrity: The full analytic convergence and fixed-space proof is stated. Finite numerical checks are not an infinite proof. Analogous general decoherence-free principles and fully monitored models are distinguished without claiming exhaustive bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Single-particle real-positive weighted even ring, no on-site terms, strictly positive dephasing only at every other site. The thermodynamic return uses the time-first order of limits. No finite-time robustness or gap bound; independent external audit not performed.
title: A product-resonance criterion for persistent memory under alternating site dephasing
